name: javmeta_search_parse_degraded
description: At least three natural-language parse requests within five minutes exceed a latency target or fail during Ollama chat.

query_condition.sql: SELECT count(*) AS violations FROM "javmeta_logs" WHERE event = 'api_usage' AND endpoint = '/api/v1/search/parse' AND ((parse_cache_status = 'miss' AND parse_duration_ms > 4000) OR (parse_cache_status = 'hit' AND parse_duration_ms > 100) OR (parse_cache_status = 'miss' AND ollama_chat_outcome IN ('http_error', 'timeout', 'transport_error', 'client_error', 'invalid_json', 'budget_exhausted'))) HAVING count(*) >= 3
